transferable_rules: Distinguish node-level neighbor aggregation from global readout over nodes.
Specify input/output object granularity; per-position embedding dimension is not final-vector width.
Fix the selected model variant before taking its layers/readout from figures and Methods.
Resolve drawn ellipses through detailed source; disclose remaining encoding/readout differences.
Retain source-stated limitations separately from details not independently implementation-audited.
nontransferable: 1000 residues and128 dimensions per position are source-specific.
ThreeGCN layers, atomic feature list and pooling choice are not universalGNN defaults.
No claim about exact edge tensor, affinity units, split independence, benchmark reproducibility, treatment efficacy or clinical safety.
